question: Where is the previously stated element placed in relation to the vidyās?
premises: Placement at the beginning of the vidyā is indicated.
Placement at the beginning of the twelvefold vidyā is indicated.
inference: The previously stated element applies at the beginning of the vidyā and of the twelvefold vidyā.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of pūrvokta is compressed and context-dependent.
plain_english: At the beginning of the vidyā, as previously stated, and at the beginning of the twelvefold vidyā.
